summaryZh: Afshari Lab 研究角膜及眼表疾病的细胞和分子机制，关注 Fuchs 角膜内皮营养不良、内皮再生、氧化毒性损伤及手术结局。方法涉及全基因组关联研究、CRISPR/Cas9、干细胞分化和成像。
researchQuestions: 哪些基因座驱动 Fuchs 角膜内皮营养不良？

evidence.quote: Afshari Lab Corneal & Ocular Surface Research Laboratory
Our lab studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying corneal and ocular surface disease
Deriving corneal endothelial cells from pluripotent stem cells

Four questions guide our work Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy causes the cornea’s hexagonal endothelial mosaic to break down cell by cell. We approach that breakdown from four angles at once: genetics, cell biology, environmental injury, and surgical outcomes. 01 — Genetics Fuchs Dystrophy Genetics Genome-wide association studies identifying the loci that drive Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy
